summary: Build practical IFRS S1/S2 reporting controls, data ownership, and readiness plans. Explore the five-day implementation clinic.
lede: Sustainability disclosure governance training helps finance, reporting, audit, and risk teams organize disclosures under IFRS S1 and IFRS S2. Participants practise assigning data owners, tracing evidence, designing controls, assessing readiness, coordinating reporting calendars, and preparing board progress updates. Exercises support practical outputs such as a responsibility matrix, control register, readiness assessment, and implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate sustainability disclosure governance, reporting controls, or oversight across finance, audit, risk, and board functions.
modules: IFRS S1/S2 Readiness and Gap Assessment
IFRS S1/S2 Data Ownership and Lineage
IIA Three Lines and Board Oversight
prerequisites: Working familiarity with corporate reporting, sustainability information, internal controls, or board oversight is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet-based tracking exercises.
